title: Open injective coefficient lower comparison
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, e:Y→T, j:V→T, eV:W→V and a:W→Y scheme morphisms with a≫e=eV≫j and with the square Cartesian. Assume j is an open immersion, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let n be any integer, assume BaseChangeProperty Λ e n [sbc-def-base-change-property], and let J be an injective étale Λ-module sheaf on V. Put G=j_*J and K=De*(G[0]). The unit K→Ra_*Da*K followed by Ra_* of the pullback composition isomorphism Da*De*≅DeV*Dj* and of the map DeV*(Dj*(G[0])→J[0]) induced by the single-complex comparison and the coefficient counit has isomorphic degree-n homology. The pullback composition is the inverse upperStarPlusComp(a,e), the equality transport a≫e=eV≫j, and upperStarPlusComp(eV,j), in that order.

source.place: closed-open argument, lower-degree comparison / Leray edge

proof.text: Apply the factorization theorem. The single-complex unit on the injective coefficient is an isomorphism, and BaseChangeProperty gives an isomorphism on the base-change factor; homology preserves their composite.

theorem open_injective_coefficient_lower_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {Y T V W : Scheme.{u}}
    (e : Y ⟶ T) (j : V ⟶ T) (eV : W ⟶ V) (a : W ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] [QuasiSeparated j]
    (wa : a ≫ e = eV ≫ j) (sq : IsPullback eV a j e)
    (n : ℤ) (hbc : BaseChangeProperty Λ e n)
    (J : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) [Injective J] :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map
      ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a).derivedPlus.unit.app
        (D+((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (((j)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj J))) ≫
        R+((a)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
          ((upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a e).inv.app _ ≫
            eqToHom (by rw [wa]) ≫
            (upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) eV j).hom.app _ ≫
            D+((eV)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
              ((((j)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
                (((j)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj J) ≫
                (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
                  ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).counit.app J)))))
